title: Sweetheart!
desc: An animator struggles with commitment issues when his girlfriend reveals that she is pregnant. His emotional journey unfolds with surprising humor, leading to personal growth and self-discovery.

title: Sangili Bungili Kadhava Thorae
desc: Vasu, a young broker, purchases a bungalow for his family in the outskirts of town. However, they soon start to feel the presence of supernatural forces in the building.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.

desc: Saravanan, an undercover officer disguised as a PT master, confronts merciless criminals, unearths their fraud and recruits school personnel to dismantle their operation.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Gurkha
desc: A group of ex-army officials takes innocent people at a shopping centre hostage. When a security guard of Gurkha descent learns that the captives include the woman he loves, he sets out to save them.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Sagodharargal
desc: Separated at childhood, identical triplets, who find their calling in life, reunite after one of them kidnaps other two brothers for his own purpose.

title: Jeeva
desc: Jeeva, who has a natural talent in cricket, dreams of playing for the Indian cricket team. However, his love life and politics in the sports governing body become obstacles to his ambition.

title: Kanithan
desc: A journalist finds himself in the crosshairs of a dreaded counterfeiting racket. Eventually, he decides to use his investigative skills to expose the racket and save his career.

desc: Pandiyan, a gang member seeking reform, is framed for murder, forcing him to disguise himself as a wealthy man's missing son to evade danger.

title: Ruler
